notes.title: 2025/03/08 Added volume settings
notes.content:
Added volume settings, you can set the volume of BGM, you can set the volume of sound effects

增加音量设置，可以设置BGM的音量大小，可以设置音效的音量大小

notes.title: 2025-02-06 Added 30 lives cheat / 新增30命秘籍
notes.content:
Added 30 lives cheat: When paused, press Z and B on the keyboard at the same time, or move the controller left and right 20 times

增加30命秘籍 ： 暂停时，同时按下键盘的z和B获得，或者手柄左右左右20次

notes.title: 2025-02-04 Added robot character / 加入机器人角色
notes.content:
Added robot character
加入机器人角色

1. Fix the issue of BOSS card BUG not moving in level 5
2. When jumping up to the top on the far right side of the map in level 6, triggering a loop to crash to death BUG fix
3. The item at the far right and bottom of the map in level 6 cannot be hit due to jumping up once. BUG fix
4. In the final BOSS second form, after the player GAME OVER, the level continuation point is changed to start from the aerial combat position

1.  第5关BOSS 卡BUG不动的问题 修复
2. 第6关地图最右方，往上跳到顶部时，触发循环摔死BUG修复
3. 第6关地图最右方，底部的道具，因往上跳了一次导致打不出来BUG修复
4. 最终BOSS第二形态，玩家GAME OVER后，续关点改为从空中战位置开始续关

1. When using alt+enter to switch to full screen in WINDOWS, the game will be bounced back to windowed mode.
2. Adjusted the color scheme of 2P female characters

1. WINDOWS使用 alt+enter 切换全屏时，在游戏中被弹回窗口化问题修正
2. 2P女角色的配色调整

notes.title: 2024-07-22 增加简单难度 / Add Easy Difficulty
notes.content:
1. Add Easy Difficulty. This difficulty has 5 lives at the beginning. The weapon is retained after the character dies. 50 kills will reward one life. Other aspects are the same as the Normal Difficulty.
2. Changed "Press any key" to "Hold any key" for 2 seconds

1.   增加 简单难度 ，这个难度初始有5生命，角色死亡后武器保留，50击杀奖励一命，其他方面和普通难度一致
2. “按任意键跳过” 改为 “按住任意键跳过”2秒

1. When resetting the game, the wingman will not be lost.
2. The location of some hidden items is more obvious

1.  重置游戏时，僚机会丢失修正为不会丢失
2.  部分隐藏道具的位置提示改为更加明显

notes.title: 2024-07-18 part2
notes.content:
1. The title screen, after 10 seconds of inactivity, the OP page is changed to 30 seconds, and the OP page will not be entered again when the settings menu is opened
2. When setting a button, if the button is not pressed for more than 10 seconds, the button setting box will be automatically closed
3. 2players, the problem of the area where the map goes down easily causing the player to fall to death has been corrected
4. 2players, the enemy's target search mechanism has been corrected
5. 2players, the color of the 2P character death animation has been corrected

1. 标题画面，静置10秒后进入OP页面修改为静置30秒，并且在打开了设置菜单时不会再进入OP页面
2. 设置按键时，如果超过10秒未按键，则自动关闭按键设置框
3. 双人游戏时，地图往下走的区域，容易导致玩家摔死的问题修正
4. 双人游戏时，敌人的寻敌目标机制修正
5. 双人游戏时，2P角色死亡动画的颜色修正

notes.title: 2024-07-18 Revise
notes.content:
Fixed the issue of left and right being reversed when controlling during pause
Fixed the duplication of the ending subtitles
